dependencies.KAN-133: DB owner to supply schema, RPC signatures, backfill and deployment readiness. Names below describe logical fields.
dependencies.extraction_1: Confirm where a full validated per-item list becomes available before case-scoped quote persistence and candidate selection. Existing ExtractionOut returns quote_version_ids only.
dependencies.work_case_display: Confirm related_cases response shape and placement with frontend.

items.source_item_key: Stable opaque string per source mail and logical item. Reordering or retrying must preserve keys.
items.evidence: Source location sufficient to disambiguate similar items.

extraction_proposal.invalid: Reject missing or conflicting keys before writing. Preserve existing handling for unavailable extraction and existing single-item cases.

storage_proposal.transaction: Lock the owner-scoped canonical source mail or its ingestion receipt. Reuse legacy initial case for its confirmed item and atomically create remaining cases and links. Persist the item-to-case result before acknowledging processing. Keep later graph execution scoped to one item's quote IDs.
storage_proposal.uniqueness: Enforce uniqueness in the database by owner, canonical source mail and source_item_key. Treat provider retries as the same canonical mail using existing mailbox-scoped receipts. Keep ACCEPTED receipts and do not recreate accepted items on replay.
storage_proposal.mail_case_links: Shared canonical initial mail plus each case's separately verified replies. Enforce owner consistency for both mail and case. Keep the shared original and remaining links when one case is accepted.
storage_proposal.related_cases: Derive from other owned cases with the same initial source mail. Exclude self and removed cases. Proposal for case detail is an ordered list of case IDs, empty for single-item cases. Derive via the initial mail only so shared replies do not introduce unrelated siblings.

access_and_reply.original: Keep API-25 owner-scoped. Case-scoped evidence, attachment reads and outbound draft source lookup use owner plus the mail-to-case link once KAN-133 is ready.
access_and_reply.reply: Retain participant and reference checks and DB revalidation. A reference to the shared initial message does not uniquely resolve a case. Use a verified case-specific outbound reference when available, otherwise keep existing ambiguous intake. Never fan out an ambiguous reply.

acceptance: Two items produce two owned cases and two links to one original. Each detail lists only the other case.
Retry with reordered items and concurrent duplicate delivery. Both return the same cases. Inject transaction failure and verify no partial case/link set.
Single-item new and pre-existing cases preserve IDs, original access and reply behavior.
Case-specific replies link only to the intended case. Shared initial reference remains ambiguous. Other owners cannot access evidence or discover siblings.
Accept one sibling and retry ingestion. The other retains its original and the accepted case stays deleted.
deployment: Confirm both upstream contracts before enabling behavior and verify using an isolated test database. This proposal does not define a deployed RPC.
